posts.body_html: Way better than anything I have right now...I left for a week and hail stripped most of my plants of what growth they'd put up.

posts.body_html: sorry to hear that Hawken!  I remember Jeremiah telling a cautionary tale as to why he doesn't grow sarrs outdoors in CO, sounds like you need a roof or some sort of cover on top to keep the hail from destroying them.
